coverage.main: Read all twelve pages of cached arXiv 1908.06281v5, including references and appendices. Visually checked PDF pp. 6,8,9,12 covering setup, algorithms and numerical transfer results.
coverage.supplement: Appendices A and B are included on p. 12: Algorithm 2 and Figure 3 examples. OpenReview returned a browser-verification challenge; no additional OpenReview material was inspected or assumed identical.
coverage.excluded_results: Figure 1 is a loss-versus-scale diagnostic. Figure 2(a) and starred source-model cells in Tables 1,2,4 are white-box results. Figure 3 illustrates images, not additional numerical rates. Table averages are summaries, not independent observations.

result_groups.population: Stated 1,000-image ILSVRC2012 validation sample; four single sources, seven evaluation models
result_groups.outcome: off-diagonal untargeted success for TIM, DIM, TI-DIM and their SI-NI combinations
result_groups.evidence: Almost correctly classified by all testing models does not state exclusion of target-clean errors. Source-success denominator filtering is not explicit. The basic released evaluator is not established as the implementation of every combination.

result_groups.population: Equal-weight four-model source ensemble; three adversarially trained targets
result_groups.outcome: untargeted success for six attack variants
result_groups.evidence: Ensemble construction is stated, but target-clean exclusion and ensemble-source-success denominator filtering are not explicit.

result_groups.population: Four-model source ensemble against HGD, R&P, NIPS-r3, FD, ComDefend and randomized smoothing
result_groups.outcome: untargeted success for MI-FGSM, TI-DIM and SI-NI-TI-DIM
result_groups.evidence: No explicit clean-correct or successful-source denominator was established for these six defense pipelines; a basic-model evaluator does not establish their policy.

result_groups.population: Inception-v3 source; Inception-v4 and Inception-ResNet-v2 targets, iteration counts 4 through 16
result_groups.evidence: The ablation varies iterations without an explicit denominator filtering statement. The white-box panel is excluded.

result_groups.population: Inception-v3 source; six other evaluation models
result_groups.outcome: off-diagonal untargeted success for FGSM, I-FGSM, PGD, C&W, NI-FGSM and SI-NI-FGSM
result_groups.evidence: The linked NI/SI-NI evaluator retains source failures and divides by 1,000. This is affirmative artifact evidence, but correspondence of its configuration/population to this table and applicability to other baselines are unverified; it is not silently extended to the whole table.

f1.evidence: Almost-correct wording supplies no separate numerical model clean accuracies. Attacked diagonals and loss diagnostics are not clean accuracies. Silence does not support no.

f2.evidence: Almost correctly classified is not an exclusion rule. The evaluator does not load clean predictions, but prior dataset selection could still filter inputs; absent evaluator filtering alone does not establish published target-clean-error inclusion.

f3.evidence: The released evaluator explicitly retains inputs irrespective of source success. Its behavior is preserved as an artifact finding, not proof that every published result uses that path. Published-scope denominator coverage remains unresolved.

f4.evidence: One-decimal rates could identify counts on exactly 1,000 unaveraged trials, but that denominator and aggregation policy are not established across all groups, including stochastic defenses and plotted ablations. Local survey-generated CSVs are not author-released outcomes.

f5.evidence: Main setup states L-infinity epsilon=16 in pixel units. C&W uses a distance-minimizing objective in Eq. 4; a numerical radius or explicit enforcement of the global radius for this baseline was not established. Under the all-result rule this remains unclear, not no; step size is not a perturbation radius.

f6.evidence: Attack generation and eight-model evaluation code link data and model downloads, but those contents were not verified. Original local data/model directories contain placeholders. Survey ports instead use SSA-derived images and converted weights, not verified original data/checkpoint bytes or runtime parity. Access failure does not establish absence.

artifact_checks.result: Remote HEAD and local commit match 4464fcd55b5f0a109f7c0190819856d449cc01b5. Read README, simple_eval.py and si_ni_fgsm.py; inspected root inventory and clean tracked script diffs. outputs_modern and si_ni_conditioned CSV/JSON are untracked survey outputs, not original released evidence. No original TensorFlow execution performed.

Lines 138-158 count ground-truth misclassification for all loaded adversarial filenames, without source-success filtering or clean-prediction inputs. Printed rates divide by constant 1,000, not processed-file count. This verifies code behavior, not preselection or all published table denominators.

Defaults epsilon=16, 10 iterations, alpha=epsilon/iterations after normalization, five scales, momentum=1; attack label is the initial unscaled prediction. Section 4.1 states 16 iterations and alpha=1.6; Algorithms 1/2 specify alpha=epsilon/T. Archived 10-step port is not an established matched Table 4 run. Post-encoding perturbation bounds untested.

bounds_checks.locator: Section 4.1 and all Section 4 empirical results
bounds_checks.reason: No numerical target clean accuracies on the reported-rate population established. Almost-correct wording has no assignable numerical clean error; port clean accuracies cannot substitute for the published population. Published source-success policies also remain unresolved. No new numerical bound extracted.

limitations: Complete denotes non-blind review of the identified main paper and included appendices, not independent coding or successful recomputation.
Released evaluator behavior is explicit evidence retained separately from unresolved correspondence to published tables.
Historical coding, archived predictions and published-number deltas remain unchanged. No claim that the paper is wrong or its artifacts absent is supported.
